company.name: National Hotel Supplies
company.distributes: Guest room biscuits and sweets: Arnott's (Tim Tam, Scotch Finger, Butternut Snap), Lotus Biscoff, Little Bakes, Gumnut and Aussie Biscuits, Mentos mints, plus jams and condiments
company.channels_supplied: Accommodation industry Australia wide through its online shop
company.fit_rationale: A family run accommodation supplier with a Biscuits and Sweets section of other companies' branded biscuits and mints for hotel rooms. Diablo's biscuits, wafers and sweets fit this range directly. Tier 3 because its website names neither its head office city nor its warehouse. Storage: sells from its own stock through its online shop, warehouse not named on its website.
